No. 1 Ranked Welterweight | result = Garcia wins by 2nd-round '''[[Technical Knockout|TKO]]''' }} '''Ryan Garcia vs. Conor Benn''', billed as '''USA vs. UK''',{{cite web|url=https://www.boxinginsider.com/headlines/garcia-vs-benn-official-dana-white-announces-sept-12-title-fight/|title=Garcia vs. Benn Official: Dana White Announces Sept. 12 Title Fight|accessdate=August 21, 2026|work=Boxing Insider|quote=Alalshikh billed the event as “USA VS UK” in his announcement.}} was a [[professional boxing]] match for the [[World Boxing Council|WBC]] [[welterweight]] championship between world champion [[Ryan Garcia]] and [[Conor Benn]]. It took place on September 12, 2026, at [[T-Mobile Arena]] in [[Paradise, Nevada]]. The fight was co-promoted by [[Zuffa Boxing]] and [[Golden Boy Promotions]], in partnership with [[The Ring Magazine|''The Ring'' magazine]], and broadcast in most countries on [[Paramount+]], with [[DAZN]] carrying the event in the United Kingdom and Ireland.{{cite news |title=Dana White Makes It Official: Ryan Garcia vs Conor Benn Sept. 12 |url=https://www.ufc.com/news/dana-white-makes-it-official-ryan-garcia-vs-conor-benn-sept-12 |work=UFC.com |date=15 July 2026 |language=en}}{{cite news |title=Conor Benn vs Ryan Garcia: WBC welterweight title fight announced in Las Vegas on September 12 |url=https://www.skysports.com/boxing/news/12040/13561973/conor-benn-vs-ryan-garcia-wbc-welterweight-title-fight-announced-in-las-vegas-on-september-12|work=Sky Sports |date=16 July 2026|language=en}}
